notes: Passive 2-way full-range install loudspeaker (90°x45° nominal beamwidth), part of EAW's MK2300i Series (siblings: MK2326i, MK2364i, MK2366i, MK2396i, MK2399i differ only in horn/coverage pattern). No AC or DC power connector — it is fully passive and draws power via speaker cable from an external power amplifier (EAW recommends UXA4403 or UXA4807D). Physical input is a screw-terminal barrier/terminal strip, not a true "Euroblock" brand connector — modeled here as connector "euroblock" as the closest listed match; EAW's own spec table literally calls it a "6-Pin Terminal Strip In + Out." Per the manufacturer's input-panel wiring diagram, the two 6-position terminal blocks (Bi-Amp Input and Passive Input LF/HF) are jumper-configurable between single-amp (passive crossover) and bi-amp (external LF/HF processing) modes; no grade applies since euroblock/terminal-strip connectors are not on any of the specified bandwidth scales. Dimensions 30 x 15.54 x 14.75 in (762 x 394.7 x 374.7 mm), net weight 60 lb (27.2 kg) — not rack-mountable, so rackUnits omitted. Verified against the official EAW MK2300i Series spec sheet PDF (dated 250724), which explicitly tabulates MK2394i alongside the rest of the series.

ports.name: Bi-Amp Input – LF
ports.note: LF +/- pair on the 6-position "Bi-Amp Input" terminal strip; used for external active crossover/DSP bi-amp operation. Nominal impedance 8Ω, rated 600W (Accelerated Life Test 69.3V).

ports.name: Bi-Amp Input – HF
ports.note: HF +/- pair on the 6-position "Bi-Amp Input" terminal strip; used for external active crossover/DSP bi-amp operation. Nominal impedance 8Ω, rated 150W (Accelerated Life Test 34.6V).

ports.name: Passive Input LF/HF
ports.note: 6-position "Passive Input LF/HF" terminal strip; single-amp operation through the internal passive crossover (LF/HF combined, 8Ω, 600W). Jumpered to the Bi-Amp Input block; also serves as a loop-through output to daisy-chain additional MK2394i units off the same amplifier channel (spec sheet lists connector as "6-Pin Terminal Strip In + Out").
